title: Compare prepared guidance tasks without manufacturing success
statement: The Authoring guidance Module shall prepare and compare participant-specific semantic authoring tasks against identified expectations, exposing actual outcomes, assistance and unassessed scope while leaving generic assurance judgments and retention to their accountable owners.

what.problem: Passing shape checks can hide incorrect semantic outcomes, missing explanations or undocumented help.
what.desired_outcome: Compare prepared guidance tasks without manufacturing success.

why.rationale: SR-034 needs an accountable MOD-008 obligation at the IF-008 guidance boundary; existing workflow AR-029/033 do not cover this complete guidance responsibility.

stakeholders: New REM authors with basic engineering knowledge

conditions: During the selected authoring/correction or prepared guidance-assessment activity, and when its material source or subject basis changes.

contexts: MOD-008 contribution to MOD-017 IF-008, with MOD-012 guided consumption and existing IF-014 assurance/IF-004 recording when selected.

how.approach: Apply guidance.md to exact declared inputs and owned source meanings; preserve actor decisions, incomplete scope and separately observed effects.

how_much.scope: The complete allocated contribution to SR-034 within the declared finite activity/profile/task scope; no universal usability, runtime automation or population claim.

acceptance_criteria: Before task performance, identify participant group, exact guidance/profile basis, prepared inputs, expected semantic outputs, rule explanation, applicable checks and assistance conditions across the declared activity coverage.

Report success only from the expected semantic outcome, passed applicable checks and an adequate rule explanation from canonical guidance; structural validity alone, absent observations or missing checks cannot establish success.

Preserve incorrect results, ambiguities, actual assistance, unsupported formats and interrupted/unperformed tasks; keep assisted and unassisted results and participant/version conclusions distinguishable.

Carry exact prepared expectations and actual task comparison separately into existing assurance preparation and selected retention; changed expectations do not rewrite prior observations, and preparation or saved content does not establish formal judgment or general usability.
constraints: Guidance and Design coverage do not establish participant success, execution authority or installed support.

sources.basis: Define source-bound guidance selection, bounded authoring/correction and participant-assisted semantic task assessment, with justified MOD-008 allocation and existing assurance/recording cooperation. Target Design only; no observed usability or installed capability claim.
